end.parentNote: Kabir practised rounding numbers and using estimated multiplication, subtraction, and addition to check reasonableness. They used place-value decomposition to work out 48 × 20 and explained why 4,982 + 3,015 is near 8,000. Kabir still mixed up an estimate with the exact answer; this was not corrected by the end. At home, ask them to label answers as “estimate” or “exact” and discuss why the two can differ.
